say:2:1027103001:0.text: Uncle Dyan, there's a ton of open space in the garden. Should we experiment with some crops?
say:2:1027103001:0.source_cn: 迪恩叔叔，我看园子里还有不少空地，要不要试验性地种点作物？

say:3:1027103002:0.text: Glowfly fruit and jumping beans are great! The fruit can be candied, the beans fried and eaten, or even turned into slingshot pellets…
say:3:1027103002:0.source_cn: 萤瓤果和跳跳豆就很不错！萤瓤果可以榨糖，跳跳豆不但可以...

say:4:1027103003:1.text: But they're only a little bit hard on your teeth!

say:5:1027103004:0.text: Another one of your crazy ideas... You're cooking up a couple of new inventions with our produce?
say:5:1027103004:0.source_cn: 你这孩子，又在出什么坏点子？不会有新发明要用到那些果子吧？

say:6:1027103005:0.text: Yes and no. And for that, I need a huge harvest! Super huge!
say:6:1027103005:0.source_cn: 也对，也不对。确实要用，而且用量很大——超级大！！

say:7:1027103006:0.text: No one in Lunadorf knows more about gardening than you, Uncle Dyan. I'm begging you!
say:7:1027103006:0.source_cn: 整座月湖村里除了迪恩叔叔你，没人更了解种植，我只能来求你了！

say:9:1027103008:0.text: Don't be so spoiled! This is something I can't promise.
say:9:1027103008:0.source_cn: ……别撒娇啊，这件事我真的不能答应你。

say:10:1027103009:1.text: If you want fruit, find someone to go pick it with.
say:10:1027103009:1.source_cn: 要是想要果子，可以找人一起陪你去采摘嘛。

say:11:1027103010:1.text: And stop pestering me here every day. Go hang out with children your own age!
say:11:1027103010:1.source_cn: 别天天在我这逛，多和你同龄的孩子一起玩玩！

say:12:1027103011:0.text: They won't help me! When I try to be friendly, they ignore me, and they never invite me to play…
say:12:1027103011:0.source_cn: 他们才不会帮我呢！和他们打招呼，他们都当没听见，出去玩...

say:13:1027103012:0.text: Why is that? I can explain the functions of mortise and tenon joints, but I can't understand them…
say:13:1027103012:0.source_cn: 究竟是为什么呢，我能想明白榫卯和螺钉的机理，也搞不懂他...

choice_prompt:14:1027103012.text: Why is that? I can explain the functions of mortise and tenon joints, but I can't understand them…
choice_prompt:14:1027103012.source_cn: 究竟是为什么呢，我能想明白榫卯和螺钉的机理，也搞不懂他们的想法！

say:15:1027103013:0.text: Bullying? Nah, I just don't get along with them!
say:15:1027103013:0.source_cn: 针对？唔，大家没那么坏啦，我只是和他们玩不到一起！

say:16:1027103014:0.text: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
say:16:1027103014:0.male: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
say:16:1027103014:0.female: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!

choice_prompt:17:1027103014.text: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.source_cn: 对了，<style=stress><player_name></style>——你可以帮我吗？很简单的，帮忙采一些果子就可以了！
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.male: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.female: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!

say:18:1027103015:1.text: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!
say:18:1027103015:1.source_cn: 放心，我懂得以物易物的道理，作为交换，把我的新发明送给你！
say:18:1027103015:1.male: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!
say:18:1027103015:1.female: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!

say:19:1027103020:0.text: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
say:19:1027103020:0.source_cn: 我得友情提醒一句，不要太期待达米安的发明，至少不要指望...
say:19:1027103020:0.male: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
say:19:1027103020:0.female: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…

choice_prompt:20:1027103020.text: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.source_cn: 我得友情提醒一句，不要太期待达米安的发明，至少不要指望它们能发挥正常功能……
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.male: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.female: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…

say:22:1027103022:0.text: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!
say:22:1027103022:0.male: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!
say:22:1027103022:0.female: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!

say:23:1027103023:0.text: Let's meet back here once we have enough!
say:23:1027103023:0.source_cn: 等找够数量了，咱们就在这儿见！
say:23:1027103023:0.male: Let's meet back here once we have enough!
say:23:1027103023:0.female: Let's meet back here once we have enough!

choice:20:1:2.text: Now I want to know more.
choice:20:1:2.male: Now I want to know more.
choice:20:1:2.female: Now I want to know more.

say:25:1027103016:0.source_cn: 哇，你连小孩子的便宜都要占吗？！

say:26:1027103017:0.text: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.
say:26:1027103017:0.source_cn: 既然这样……那我就忍痛割爱，把我的新发明送给你好了。
say:26:1027103017:0.male: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.
say:26:1027103017:0.female: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.

say:27:1027103018:1.text: Well... Lorsan can help! I'll even throw in one of my latest inventions!
say:27:1027103018:1.source_cn: 嗯……当然，洛桑大哥也行！我会附赠最新发明！

say:30:1027103019:0.text: How'd I get roped in? And when did you become so resourceful?!
say:30:1027103019:0.source_cn: ——这么快就找上我了？你怎么这时候这么机灵？！

choice:17:2:3.text: Does it have to be me?
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 采果子这种事还要我来？
choice:17:2:3.male: Does it have to be me?
choice:17:2:3.female: Does it have to be me?

choice:14:0:1.text: Are the other kids bullying you?
choice:14:0:1.male: Are the other kids bullying you?
choice:14:0:1.female: Are the other kids bullying you?
